test_title: PYST 36: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If C × M ÷ S - K + T - Q, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: C is K’s mother’s sister’s husband

solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbe949c88b7ad8655c0f554c90c173f35e5c348f1820bc7c131790e158710e90.png] 

Given Statement: C × M ÷ S - K + T - Q ⇒

 

C is the Husband of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08412f925989f71b1a8630dfac8acd71d8b6135375a83c2f8b5dbf9971db743.png] 

 

M is the sister of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acc3025a8d12917133c428d9f0a5656a7c6081dc14cd4e119b2f5bb6739166b0.png] 

 

S is the Mother of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98f23b11177cd35602c3fac7326f9eaff195b7e05d9dcb17f9ecf2f01aa4ce97.png] 

K is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea9773875a20e23e2bb06adfa9cf6f9d3b5badb5e54ee3c497752d24cb034ae.png] 

T is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b27bc9fb65afca41f1bee3daa9bcabe9cb4afff04e2ac86ccbdf1f92087fda0.png] 

Option (1)- S is Q’s mother’s father (**NOT correct**, as S is a female.)

Option (2)- K is Q’s mother’s brother (Correct)

Option (3)- M is T’s mother’s sister (Correct)

Option(4)- C is K’s mother’s sister’s husband (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (1)**.
